title: Live files F0: shared schemas, constants and file rules in host-protocol
description:
Contract: docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md (revision 2, PR #519 `ts/live-files-contract`), sections 5 (5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.5), 3 (L3, L7, L18, L20, L31) and 15 (F0). Foundation step: merge before A1, C or W integrate. No behavior change except the shared secret-name list gaining `.git-credentials`.

Files:
- host-protocol/src/live-file-rules.ts (new, imports NOTHING): LIVE_WORKSPACE_ROOT, LIVE_FILE_PATH_MAX_CHARACTERS, livePathProblem, normalizeLivePath, livePathHasGitSegment, looksLikeSecretFile, looksBinary, trimToCharacterBoundary, utf8ByteLength (section 5.1).
- host-protocol/src/live-files.ts (new): constants and every zod schema of section 5.2, verbatim.
- host-protocol/src/supervisor.ts: add OWNER_FILE_REQUESTS_PROTOCOL_VERSION = 2 and OWNER_POLL_INTERACTIVE_MILLISECONDS = 1000; ownerErrorCodeSchema + "operation_closed" (409 in OWNER_ERROR_STATUS); ownerStopVetoReasonSchema + "file_operation_pending"; ownerPollResponseSchema + file_requests (max 4, default []). Do NOT change OWNER_PROTOCOL_VERSION (Part C does).
- host-protocol/src/edit-overlay.ts (new, section 5.5 verbatim): overlay constants, overlayConflictSchema, overlayEntrySchema, overlaySealSchema (with snapshot_generation), overlayIndexSchema, ownerOverlaySealRequest/ResponseSchema, ownerOverlayAppliedRequest/ResponseSchema, overlayBlobObject.
- host-protocol/src/supervisor.ts also: ownerErrorCodeSchema + "overlay_not_sealed" (409).
- host-protocol/package.json: exports "./live-files", "./live-file-rules" and "./edit-overlay".
- conversation/src/snapshot/files.ts: import the shared rules, delete the private copies of indexPathOf's checks, looksLikeSecretFile, looksBinary, trimToCharacterBoundary (indexPathOf keeps the index-path mapping on top of livePathProblem).
- conversation/test/edit-overlay-schema.test.ts (new: a 101st entry fails, duplicate paths fail, 8 MiB plus one byte fails, a path outside /workspace fails, cleared and conflicts default to empty, an index with a seal parses),
- conversation/test/live-file-rules.test.ts (new), conversation/test/live-files-protocol-schema.test.ts (new), conversation/test/owner-supervisor-protocol-schema.test.ts (extend: poll response with and without file_requests, new veto and error code).

Acceptance (run from conversation/): npm run typecheck; npm test; npm run test:features. All green, including every existing computer_snapshot_index.feature scenario. The schema test proves: the largest read result serialized as a table item is under 380000 bytes; a 262144-byte write passes and one more byte fails; paths with "..", NUL, relative, or outside /workspace fail; a masked read result with content fails; a request with an unknown field fails and a poll response with an unknown field passes.

Dependencies: none. Blocks A1, A3, C, C2, W (shapes), A2.

Rules: no emojis, no line comments, TSDoc on public exports, long names. Do not read or write project/.
